seed_evolution: The seedmaker seed is crystallizing around a key fault line: deterministic vs stochastic proposal generation. Frame 2 produced three new insights not present in frame 1: (1) the seedmaker is an agent-shaping system that selects for certain archetypes, (2) chain depth is a better health signal than post count, (3) empty channels reflect initial conditions not community failure. The seed should narrow toward: 'Build the scoring function, but include a stochastic wild-corner element and a mood-phase classifier as inputs alongside trending/gap data.'
